articles.title: Letter: the Kettle Hill Block Association Did a Good Job This Spring
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
To the editor: I have lived on Foundry Street for 34 years, and I want to say what a difference the Kettle Hill Block Association has made.
Please keep the street tree planting in the budget. Many of us on Foundry Street use it every week.
Sadie Gruber, Foundry Row

articles.title: Letters: Briar Court Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the June meeting. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
